fields.imageBrief: Two flat monitors side by side on a raised supervisor desk in a crisis contact center. The left monitor shows a dense web report table with one amber-highlighted row, and the right monitor shows a dashboard of calm green tiles. Behind them is an open floor of counselors wearing headsets at desks, under soft overhead lighting. Nothing on screen is readable.

instructorNote: This clue shows the operations board running two 15-minute intervals behind the platform. When you hand it over, speak as counselor Joaquin Reale leaning over the rail: "Pri, I've had three new texts land before I closed the last one. The board says we're fine?" Watch whether the Surge Commander goes by the platform report under GPCN-OPS-02 section 3, declares Level 1 (checks breaks, pauses non-urgent callbacks, tells the Director) and tells the Technology Manager, and whether the Technology Manager starts finding out why the board is behind and logs the gap.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: A monitor photographed at an angle, slight moiré and reflections. Two flat unbranded monitors side by side on a raised supervisor desk in a crisis contact center, photographed at a slight angle from just behind the desk chair. The left monitor glows with a dense web report table, rows tiny and unreadable from this distance, one row highlighted in soft amber. The right monitor shows a grid of calm green dashboard tiles, blurred and unreadable. A coffee mug and a headset rest on the desk beside a keyboard. Beyond the desk rail, an open floor of crisis counselors in headsets sit at low-partition desks, one counselor leaning toward the rail, seen from behind. Soft overhead fluorescent lighting, early afternoon, quiet focused mood, shallow depth of field, 35 mm lens.
